t: Totality runs your gym from one app. You can sell memberships and PT packages, take card payments, run classes and bookings, manage your trainers, pay them, keep their certificates up to date, follow up leads and see your numbers. Your trainers get their own login to coach their clients, and your members get the app to book, pay, train and message. This guide is for the gym owner or admin, the person who set up the gym's Totality account. Trainers and members have their own guides. Your dashboard is the first thing you see when you sign in

Where Totality runs # Totality works on iPhone, Android and the web. On a computer, go to totalityapp.com.au and sign in with the same email and password. Everything in this guide works in all three places, except push notifications, which need the phone app. App updates Most updates arrive by themselves. Open the app, close it fully, then open it again and you have the latest version. A fresh install also needs that one close and reopen.

Where to start # If you are new, work through these in order: Pick a plan or start your free trial ( Signing up ). Connect Stripe so members can pay you. Invite your trainers . Set up your memberships and PT packages . Bring your members across from your old software, or add them one by one . Create your classes and put them on the timetable. Tali says G'day, I'm Tali. I live in the app and keep an eye on the gym for you. I'll flag what needs you each morning and draft the boring messages. You just say yes.

Getting help # There is a round purple ? button on every screen. Tap it to report a problem or ask for help. You give it a title, a description and a priority (low, medium, high or urgent) and it goes straight to the Totality team. You can also email admintotality@gmail.com .

Questions # Do my trainers need their own Totality plan? No. Trainers you invite to your gym are covered by your gym plan. If a trainer already pays for a Solo plan, it is cancelled when they join your gym. See Trainers . Do my members pay anything to use the app? No. Members use the app for free. They only pay you, for the memberships, packages, classes and products you sell. Can I use Totality on my computer at the front desk? Yes. Sign in at totalityapp.com.au in any web browser. Everything works there except push notifications. Is there a quick tour? Yes. The first time you open the dashboard, Tali walks you round it in under a minute. See Signing up .

t: Totality has three plans for gyms and studios. They all have the same tools. They differ by how many members you can have, how many Tali AI credits come with the plan, and whether your own branding is included. Every price is in Australian dollars.

The three gym plans # Studio Club Enterprise Monthly A$389.99 A$649.99 A$999.99 Yearly (15% off) A$3,977.90 A$6,629.90 A$10,199.90 Members (clients) Up to 500 Up to 1,500 Up to 5,000 Trainers Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited Tali AI credits 1,000 a month 2,500 a month Unlimited Your logo and colours Add-on, A$9.99 a month Included Included More than 5,000 members, or need a custom setup? Email admintotality@gmail.com for a quote.

What every gym plan includes # All the trainer tools: programme builder, session logging, check-ins, nutrition tracking, messaging and appointments Unlimited trainers Member billing and POS (taking payments in person) Classes and scheduling Payroll summary Compliance hub Leads CRM Import wizard Marketplace (selling memberships, packs and products in the app) Reports and exports The POS add-on that Solo trainers buy is already included on every gym plan. The plan picker in the app Club and Enterprise

The free trial # Every new account starts with a 7-day free trial . You do not need a card to start it. During the trial you get the full Studio experience, so you can set up memberships, classes, trainers and payroll and see how it all fits your gym. Three days before the trial ends we send you a reminder email. If you have not picked a plan when the trial ends, your account becomes read only: you can still open Billing and Settings, but every other screen shows Your free trial has ended with a Choose a plan button. Your members, programmes and history are kept safe, and everything switches back on as soon as you subscribe.

The first-months discount # The first time your gym subscribes on a monthly plan, you get 50% off your first 2 months . It is applied automatically at checkout, no code needed. If another gym or trainer referred you (you entered their code when you signed up, or used their share link), you get 70% off your first 2 months on a monthly plan instead. That is the 20% referral discount and the 50% welcome discount together. Yearly plans do not get these discounts. The yearly checkout has a box for a promo code instead.

Add-ons # Add-on Price Who can buy it Tali AI, +3,000 credits a month for the whole gym A$19.99 a month Studio and Club Branding (your logo, name and colour) A$9.99 a month Studio (Club and Enterprise include it) Tali + Branding bundle A$24.99 a month Studio, A$4.99 less than buying both Enterprise needs no add-ons: Tali is unlimited and branding is included. See Your Totality plan to buy or cancel an add-on.

Fees on member payments # There is no commission on your coaching or membership revenue. A 3.5% platform fee applies to payments members make through the app (memberships, PT packages, classes, POS and shop sales). It comes out of your payout and is never added to what your members pay. Stripe's own card fees also apply. See Stripe Connect and payouts .

Refer another gym # In Settings , the Refer & Earn card gives you a referral code and share link. The gym or trainer you refer gets 70% off their first 2 months on a monthly plan. You get 20% off your plan for each one who becomes a paying customer, and the discounts stack up to 100% while your subscription is active.

Questions # Why does the plan picker not show prices? The Choose a plan screen lists what each plan includes. The price for the plan and billing period you picked shows on the Stripe checkout page in the next step. The prices are also on this page and at totality360.com.au/pricing.html. Can I change plan later? Yes, at any time. Open Sales , then Your Totality plan , then Change plan . See Your Totality plan . What counts as a member for the plan limit? Active members of your gym. Trainers and admins do not count. The dashboard shows how many you have used, for example "48 of 500 members used on your plan", and warns you when you reach 90%. What happens if I hit my member limit? You cannot add another active member until you move up a plan or make someone inactive. The dashboard shows Member limit reached and tapping it opens the plan picker. Is there a Solo plan for gyms? Solo plans are for one independent trainer. They do not include classes, multiple trainers, the compliance hub or reports. A gym needs Studio, Club or Enterprise. Do I get a refund if I cancel? Cancelling stops the next payment. You keep access until the end of the period you have paid for. See Your Totality plan

t: Totality takes member payments through Stripe , a payments company used by millions of businesses. Your gym gets its own Stripe Express account. Members pay by card in the app, and the money goes to your Stripe balance and then to your bank. You need Stripe connected before you can sell memberships, PT packages, paid classes, POS payment links, one-off charges or shop products.

Connect Stripe # Tap the Sales tab. Until Stripe is set up, an orange Connect Stripe to get paid card sits at the top. Tap it, or tap Stripe Connect setup . Read the Connect your Stripe account card and tap Connect Stripe account . Stripe opens in your browser. Enter your business details, your ID and the bank account you want payouts to go to. Stripe checks these for you (this is called KYC). When Stripe says you are done, come back to Totality. Pull down on the Connect Stripe screen to refresh it. Before you connect Connected, with charges and payouts on When everything is approved, the screen says Stripe connected with a green tick next to Charges and Payouts . The Connect payments step on your dashboard's setup card ticks itself off.

If Stripe needs more details # If you left Stripe before finishing, the screen says Onboarding in progress and the button changes to Complete Stripe setup . Your dashboard shows Finish your Stripe setup . Tap the button to carry on where you left off. Payments and payouts start once Stripe has everything it needs.

Managing payouts # Payout timing, your bank account and tax details are managed by Stripe. Use the Stripe Express dashboard at dashboard.stripe.com to see payouts, update your bank account or answer any Stripe questions.

The platform fee # Commission on your coaching or membership revenue None Platform fee on payments members make in the app 3.5% Who pays it You, out of the payout. It is never added to what your member pays Stripe card fees Charged by Stripe as normal The fee applies to memberships, PT packages, paid class bookings, POS payment links, one-off charges and shop sales. Payouts, net of the fee, go straight to your bank. Your Totality subscription is separate What you pay Totality for your plan is billed to your own card. It has nothing to do with your Stripe Connect account. See Your Totality plan .

Questions # How long does Stripe take to approve me? Often a few minutes. If Stripe needs extra documents it can take longer, and Stripe will email you. When does money reach my bank? On Stripe's payout schedule for your account. You can see and change it in the Stripe Express dashboard. Can I use the Stripe account I already have? Totality creates a new Stripe Express account for your gym, connected to Totality. You sign in to it with your email. Your old Stripe account and its customers are not moved across. Do my members need a Stripe account? No. They just add a card in the Totality app. Why does revenue in Totality look 3.5% lower than the amount charged? Totality shows what you actually receive, after the platform fee. See Revenue and insights .

t: With branding, Totality shows your gym to your members and trainers: your logo and name at the top of the app, your colour on the tab bar, main buttons and home screens, and your branding on member emails and push notifications. The app in the App Store and its icon stay Totality. Branding is an add-on on Studio A$9.99/mo and included on Club and Enterprise. You can try a look before you pay.
Open Branding # Open More , then Settings , then Branding under Tools. You can also reach it from the BRANDING card on your plan screen. Branding before the add-on is on Invite link and preview

Set your look # LOGO : tap Choose logo and pick a square PNG or JPG under 2 MB. A transparent background looks best. Tap Remove to take it off again. BUSINESS NAME : the name members see. Leave it blank to use your gym's name from Settings. BRAND COLOUR : tap one of the colour dots, type a hex code like #0F766E, or tap Use Totality orange . Totality checks the colour is dark enough for white text to be readable. If it says "Too light to read white text on", pick a darker shade. INVITE LINK : choose the end of your join link, for example totalityapp.com.au/join/iron-works. Use 3 to 40 letters, numbers or dashes, not starting or ending with a dash. Check PREVIEW: WHAT YOUR CLIENTS SEE . Tap Save branding . Without the add-on, the button says Needs the branding add-on and you cannot save yet.

Buy the add-on (Studio) # At the top of the Branding screen, the Branding is an add-on card has an Add branding, $9.99/mo button. It opens a Stripe checkout. Once paid, come back and tap Save branding . One add-on covers your whole gym, every trainer and member. If you also want more Tali AI credits, the Tali + Branding bundle on your plan screen is A$24.99 a month, A$4.99 less than buying both. See Your Totality plan . To cancel the add-on, tap Cancel add-on on the Branding screen. It stays on until the end of the period you have paid for. Changed your mind before then? Tap Keep branding .

Your join link # Share your join link (on your website, Instagram bio or in a welcome email) so new members see your branding on the sign in screen. The page offers Get the app on iPhone , Get the app on Android and Sign in on the web . The join link does not create accounts. You still add members yourself, and they get their login by email. If someone opens a link that is no longer active, they see "This invite link isn't active" and can still sign in. Powered by Totality "Powered by Totality" stays in Settings for your members. Everything else they see uses your brand.

Questions # Where will my members see my branding? At the top of their app, on the tab bar and main buttons, on their home screen, on the sign in screen (once they have signed in on that device or used your join link), and on emails and push notifications from your gym. Will the app icon on their phone change? No. The app in the App Store and Google Play, and its icon, stay Totality. My colour will not save. It is probably too light for white text. Pick a darker shade until the warning goes away. Someone else already has my link name. Each join link is unique. If yours is taken you will see "Link taken". Try a different ending, for example add your suburb. I'm on Club. Do I need to pay for branding? No. Branding is included on Club and Enterprise. Just set it up and tap Save branding .

t: You decide which alerts reach you. Open More , then Settings , and scroll to NOTIFICATIONS , EMAIL and QUIET HOURS . Each switch saves as soon as you tap it. Notification settings in the phone app. On the web this section shows a note instead.

Push notifications # Push notifications need the Totality phone app on iPhone or Android. On the web, this section says Push notifications are available in the phone app . Switch When you get one Push notifications Turns every push on or off Messages When a client sends you a message Client logged a session When a client finishes a training session Client submitted a check-in When a client sends their weekly check-in New client added When a new client is added to your list New member joined When a new member joins your gym Staff messages When a staff member sends you a message On iPhone, the first time the app asks, tap Allow so notifications can come through. If you tapped Don't Allow, turn them on in your iPhone's Settings, then Notifications, then Totality. On Android, check Settings, then Apps, then Totality, then Notifications.

Email # Email notifications : turns all non-essential emails on or off. Tips and reports : weekly reports, tips and feature news. Essential emails, like password resets, still come through when this is off.

Quiet hours # Quiet hours holds non-urgent notifications between 9pm and 7am. They arrive after 7am instead. Your members' settings Each member and trainer has their own notification settings. When you send a group announcement , Totality respects each person's choices, including their quiet hours and email unsubscribe.

Questions # I'm not getting push notifications. Check you are using the phone app, not the website. Make sure Push notifications is on here and that your phone allows notifications for Totality. Quiet hours may be holding them overnight. Does turning off email stop my members' emails? No. These switches only change what you receive. Members manage their own emails in their app.

t: The Import wizard brings your data across from a spreadsheet or your old gym software in four steps: pick what you are importing, upload the file, match the columns, then import. You can run it as many times as you like, one file per run. Open it from Members , then Import data , or from Settings , then Import . The dashboard's setup card also has a link. We can do it for you Rather not do it yourself? Email your spreadsheet to the Totality team (the address is on the dashboard's Set up your gym card, or use admintotality@gmail.com) and we will import it for you, free.

Before you start # Export your data from your old system as CSV , XLS or XLSX . See File formats and columns for exactly what each import needs and how to export from PTminder, ABC Trainerize and Mindbody. Import your trainers first , then your clients. The client import can link each member to their trainer, but only to trainers already in your gym. Check your plan's member limit. The import cannot add more active members than your plan allows. Each run imports up to 2,000 rows . Split bigger files into parts.

Step 1: Type # Pick one type for this run under What would you like to import? Type What it brings in Clients Members: names, emails, phones, date of birth, membership status, start date, emergency contacts, assigned trainer Trainers / Staff Names, emails, phones, role, hire date, certifications Payment History Past payments: client email, date, amount, description, method, status Membership Types Your membership options: name, price, billing cycle, session count Attendance / Sessions Past visits: client email, date, session name, attended or no-show Mindbody A Mindbody client list, read as-is PTminder PTminder client exports, read as-is Documents / Waivers Client email, document type, signed date, expiry date Under MIGRATING FROM ANOTHER PLATFORM? there are step-by-step export guides for PTminder , ABC Trainerize and Mindbody . Tap one to open it, follow the steps, then tap its Start Import button. Tap Next: Upload File . Step 1: pick what you are importing The Mindbody export guide

Step 2: Upload # Tap Select File ("Tap to browse your device: CSV, XLS, or XLSX"). Pick your file. Exports straight from Mindbody can be uploaded as they are, without opening or converting them first. Check PREVIEW: FIRST 5 ROWS looks right. If your file has more than 2,000 rows, you will see a warning that only the first 2,000 will be imported. Tap Next: Map Columns . Tap the file name if you want to pick a different file. Step 2: the file preview

Step 3: Map columns # Totality matches your column headings to its own fields automatically. Check each one under REQUIRED FIELDS and OPTIONAL FIELDS , and change any that are wrong by tapping the field and picking the right column. Pick Skip this field for anything you do not want to bring in. Check the guesses. An exact heading wins, so a Phone column goes to Phone and an Emergency Phone column goes to Emergency Contact Phone . Required fields must be matched before you can go on. For Clients these are Full Name and Email . If you match Assigned Trainer , the screen lists Trainers in your gym, matched by name . A member is linked to a trainer when the value in your file matches the trainer's full name or email exactly (capitals do not matter). LIVE PREVIEW: FIRST 3 ROWS shows how your first rows will come in. Tap Next: Review & Import . Step 3: match your columns

Step 4: Review and import # Totality checks which emails already have an account ("Checking for existing records...") and shows: New records to create Existing records to update Skipped (missing required fields) : rows with no name or a missing or invalid email Skipped (same email as an earlier row) : shows if an email is in your file more than once. Only the first row with that email is imported Tap Import N Records . A progress screen shows "Importing 12 of 48..." Keep the app open until it finishes. Step 4: review the counts Import complete

When it finishes # Import Complete shows how many were Created , Updated , Skipped (missing data) , Skipped (duplicate email) and Failed . If any emails were in the file more than once, it lists them. A trainer import also tells you if any rows asked for an admin role (see the Role column ). If any failed, tap Download Error Report to get a list of those rows and why, fix them in your spreadsheet and import just those rows again. Tap Import Another File to start the next run, or Done to finish. Now go through After importing .

What happens to imported members # For each new member, Totality: creates their account and adds them to your gym emails them an invite from your gym with their login details and a temporary password saves their phone, date of birth and emergency contact sets their membership status and start date, if you included them links them to their trainer, if you included an assigned trainer that matches If an email already has a Totality account, their details are updated instead and no new invite is sent. Invites go out straight away Each new member gets their invite email during the import. If you are not ready for members to log in yet, wait to run the client import until you are.

Questions # Can I undo an import? No. Check the preview and the mapping carefully first. If something went wrong, email admintotality@gmail.com. What if the same email is in my file twice? Only the first row with that email is imported, so they get one invite. The other rows are skipped (capitals do not matter) and listed on the Import Complete screen, so check that the first row was the one you wanted. Can I import programmes or workout history? Not with this wizard. Most systems, including ABC Trainerize, do not offer a self-serve export of programmes or workout history. Keep your old account until you no longer need that history. Does importing move my members' payments across? No. Billing in your old system keeps running until you stop it there. See After importing for how to move members onto Totality billing.

t: This page is the reference for the Import wizard : what to put in your spreadsheet so everything comes across cleanly.

File types # CSV (comma separated values), the most common export format XLS and XLSX (Excel workbooks) Exports that come out of a button called "Export" but are really a web table or tab separated text. Mindbody does this. The wizard reads these as they are. The first row must be your column headings. Each row after that is one record. Up to 2,000 rows per run.

Columns for each import type # Bold fields are required. Column names in your file do not have to match exactly: the wizard guesses, and you can fix any match on the Map Columns step. Clients # Field Notes Full Name One column with the whole name Email Must be a real email address. Used as the login Phone Date of Birth See dates below Membership Status active, inactive, lead or cancelled (see statuses below) Member Since Date Their start date Emergency Contact Name Emergency Contact Phone Assigned Trainer The trainer's full name or email, exactly as it is in Totality Trainers / Staff # Field Notes Full Name Email Used as their login Phone Role Optional. Everyone is imported as a trainer. See the note below Hire Date Certifications Comma separated, for example First Aid, Cert IV Role column Everyone in a trainer import is added as a trainer, whatever the Role column says. If any rows say admin, manager or owner, the Import Complete screen tells you how many. Only the gym owner can make someone an admin, in the app after the import. Payment History # Field Notes Client Email Matched to the member with that email Date Amount Dollars, for example 29.00 Description Payment Method cash,

Dates # Dates are read the Australian way, day first: 03/04/2025 , 3/4/2025 and 3/4/25 are all 3 April 2025. You can use / - or . between the numbers. 2025-04-03 (YYYY-MM-DD) works too. A date with the month written out, like 3 April 2025 , is read as written. Two digit years up to this year are 2000s, later ones are 1900s, so a birthday of 15/6/90 is 1990. Real date cells in an Excel file come through correctly whatever format they show in. If a date cannot be a real date (for example 31/02/2025) it is left empty.

How statuses are read # The wizard looks for words in your status columns, so most systems' wording works: Your file says something like Saved as cancelled, cancel Cancelled inactive, suspended, frozen Inactive lead, prospect, trial Lead anything else, or blank Active For payments: fail or declined is Failed, refund is Refunded, pending is Pending, anything else is Paid. Payment methods: cash; bank, EFT or transfer; card, credit, debit or Stripe; anything else is Other. For attendance: no or absent is No-show, late or cancel is Late cancel, anything else is Attended.

Exporting from other systems # PTminder # Log in to your PTminder account. Go to Reports in the left sidebar. Select Client List and download it as CSV. Go to Reports , then Payments , and download as CSV. Go to Reports , then Attendance , and download as CSV. Upload each file separately, one import run per file. Use the PTminder type for the client list, Payment History for payments and Attendance / Sessions for attendance. ABC Trainerize # Log in to ABC Trainerize on the web (not the mobile app). Open the Clients tab in the left-hand menu. Select all clients, or tick just the ones you want to bring over. Click the Export icon to download a CSV. In Totality, open the ABC Trainerize guide on the Import screen and tap Start Client Import , then upload that CSV. This export only includes first name, last name, email, phone and trainer name. It has no workout history, programmes or weight logs, and Trainerize does not offer a self-serve export of those. Keep your Trainerize account active, or ask their support for a manual export, if you need that history. First and last name in separate columns? Totality needs one Full Name column. In your spreadsheet, add a column with a formula lik

Questions # My file has a column the wizard does not know. Will it break? No. Columns you do not match are ignored. Can I import a file with first and last names in separate columns? Join them into one Full Name column first. See the tip above. Do I need the Membership Status column? No. Without it, members come in as active.

t: How your existing members get in # Every member you imported was emailed an invite from your gym with their login details and a temporary password. When they first sign in, they are asked to set their own password. Tell members to look out for the email (and check spam). If someone lost theirs, they can use Forgot Password? on the sign in screen with the same email. Members who already had a Totality account (for example from another gym or a trainer) are not sent a new password. Add them with Add client : they get an invite inside the app and join your gym when they tap Accept .

t: Getting members onto Totality billing # The import does not move anyone's payments. Their direct debits or card subscriptions keep running in your old system until you stop them there. To move a member across without charging them twice: Connect Stripe and create your memberships in Totality. Ask the member to add a card in the Totality app. From their profile you can tap Request Payment Method to send them a reminder. See Client detail . Pick a changeover date, ideally the day after their last payment in the old system. Cancel their billing in the old system. Start their membership in Totality: Memberships , then Members , then Add membership . Their card is charged and billing continues on the frequency you set. Members can also buy a membership themselves from your shop in the app. See Marketplace and shop .

Trainers start using Totality for programmes and sessions. Weeks 2 to 4: move members' billing across in batches, on each member's next billing date. Take new sign-ups only in Totality. When billing is all moved: keep your old system read only until you no longer need its history, then close it. Tali says Do your trainers first. Once they're in, the members follow, and I can start flagging who's gone quiet. Easy as.

t: Every trainer at your gym gets their own Totality login with the trainer tools: their clients, programmes, sessions, check-ins and messages. They are covered by your gym plan, and your plan has no limit on trainers. Trainers are under the More tab, then Staff , then Trainers . Inviting more than one trainer needs a gym plan Studio Club Enterprise . Your trainers One trainer and their clients

Invite a trainer # Open Staff , then Invite trainer . Or tap + Invite at the top of the Trainers list. Type their Full Name and Email . Tap Invite Trainer . Invite a trainer What happens next depends on the email: If the email You see What happens Is new to Totality Trainer invited : "Invite email sent to ... with login credentials." Their account is made and they get an email with their login and a temporary password. They set their own password the first time they sign in Already has a Totality account Trainer invited : "They already have a Totality account. They will join your gym once they accept the invite in the app." They see an invite at the top of their app with Accept and Decline . Nothing is linked until they accept If a trainer who pays for their own Solo plan accepts, their Solo plan and any add-ons they bought are cancelled at the end of their paid period, because your gym now covers them. Their own independent clients stay with them.

The Trainers list # Each trainer shows their name, email, an Active or Inactive badge and how many clients they have. Tap a trainer to see their phone, when they joined, their Active clients count and the list of their clients. To give a member to a trainer, or move members between trainers, use Clients . See Members .

Deactivate a trainer # Use this when someone is on leave or has left and you may want them back. Tap the trainer, then Deactivate trainer . Read the message and tap Deactivate . They lose access to your gym and its members straight away, and their clients at your gym become unassigned. Their own independent clients stay with them. You will see how many clients are now unassigned, so you can give them to another trainer from Clients. To bring them back, tap the trainer and Reactivate trainer . Their old clients are not given back automatically, so assign them again from Clients.
Remove a trainer # Remove from gym does the same as deactivating and also ends their place in your gym. They no longer appear in your list. You can invite them again later.

Roles # There are two kinds of login at a gym: Gym owner or admin (you): everything in this guide. Trainer : the trainer tools for their own clients, the gym's members list, the schedule and their own roster shifts. Trainers cannot see your billing, payroll, revenue or settings. On the staff roster you can also give each shift a role label, like front desk, floor or PT.

Questions # Do I pay extra for each trainer? No. Every gym plan includes unlimited trainers. The trainer never got the email. Ask them to check spam. They can also use Forgot Password? on the sign in screen with the email you invited. If they already had an account, they need to open the app and accept the invite at the top of their home screen. Can a trainer see all my members? Trainers see their own clients in full. They can see your gym's members list with basic details, so they can help on the floor, but not other trainers' clients' programmes or notes. Can a trainer take payments? Trainers at your gym can create POS payment links for your gym. The money goes to your gym's Stripe account. See Charges and POS .

t: The Staff roster is a weekly grid of your staff (down the side) by day (across the top). Your trainers see their own upcoming shifts in their app under My shifts . Open More , then Staff , then Rosters . The staff roster for one week At the top you see the week's totals, for example "11 shifts, 60.5 hours this week". Use the arrows either side of the dates to move between weeks. Each person's row shows their total hours for the week. Scroll sideways to see the rest of the week. Everyone with a trainer or admin place at your gym appears on the roster, including you.

Add a shift # Tap an empty cell (the + ) for that person and day. Check Staff and Date , and set the Start and end times. Optional: add a Role ("Front desk, floor, PT...") and Notes ("Open up, cover for..."). Tap Save .
Change or delete a shift # Tap the shift, change anything and tap Save , or tap Delete .

Copy a week # Copy last week fills this week with last week's shifts. Copy to next week copies this week's shifts into next week. Shifts that already exist (same person, same day, same start time) are not doubled up, so it is safe to tap these more than once.

Questions # Do trainers get told about new shifts? They see their shifts for the next 14 days in their app under My shifts. There is no separate alert for a new shift, so let them know if you make a late change. Does the roster feed into payroll? No. Payroll pays completed sessions, classes and the hours you log in Payroll. The roster is for planning. See Payroll . Someone is missing from the roster. Only trainers and admins of your gym appear. Invite them as a trainer first.

t: Payroll works out what each trainer has earned in a pay period from the work recorded in Totality: completed PT sessions, completed classes they taught, and hours you log. You set the rates once, open a pay period, and Totality adds it up. Paying people still happens through your bank or Xero . Open More , then Staff , then Payroll . It is also under Settings , then Payroll & Xero . Payroll with an open period per trainer One trainer's breakdown

1. Set pay rates # Tap Pay Rates to open it. Each trainer has their own rates. Tap Add Rate next to a trainer and fill in: Rate Name : for example PT Session. Rate Type : Type Badge Pays Per session PT Each completed 1:1 PT session Per class Class Each completed class they taught Hourly Hourly Hours you log for them Custom Custom A fixed amount, once per pay period Amount (AUD) : for example 45.00. Session length (minutes) , for PT rates only: "Sessions of this length are paid at this rate. Leave blank to pay any length that doesn't have its own rate." So you can pay 45 minute sessions at one rate and 60 minute sessions at another. Tap Save . Tap a rate to edit it, or the bin to delete it. Pay rates for each trainer One rate per kind Each trainer can have one PT rate per session length, one class rate, and one hourly rate per name. If two rates clash, Payroll will not pay that trainer until you fix it, and shows Fix rates . A trainer with no rate for a kind of work shows Set rate .

2. Open a pay period # Tap + New Period at the top. Under Trainer , pick one trainer, or All Trainers to open a period for everyone at once. Enter the Period Start and Period End dates (YYYY-MM-DD). Tap Confirm . A trainer with no open period shows "No open period. Tap + to create".

3. Check the breakdown # Tap a trainer to open their period. You see: PT sessions : the count at each rate, with the date, time, client and length of each session. Classes : classes they taught that are marked complete. Hours : hours you logged, at the hourly rate. Any custom amounts. TOTAL . Only work that is marked complete counts. If sessions or classes in the period are not marked complete yet, a note tells you how many. Settle sessions on the gym schedule (or the trainer does in their app) and mark classes complete on Classes . Anything completed after you pay a period is added to the next one, and the trainer's card shows "Has unpaid late sessions. Create a period to pay them".

4. Log hours # For floor shifts, front desk or anything not booked in Totality: In the trainer's period, tap Add hours . Enter the Date , Hours (for example 2.5), the Rate if they have more than one hourly rate, and optional Notes (for example Induction shift). Tap Save . If a trainer has no hourly rate you will see "No hourly rate is set for this trainer, so these hours can't be paid until one is added." Tap the bin next to an entry to delete it.

5. Pay and record it # Pay the trainer through your bank or payroll system. Tap Mark as Paid . Check the amount and dates in the message and tap Mark as paid . The period moves to Past Periods with a PAID badge. The paid amount flows into your Expenses report as staff pay. Export CSV downloads the period's breakdown as a spreadsheet, for your accountant or payroll system.

Questions # Why is a session missing from the total? It is not marked complete. Sessions booked with no credit stay "pending settlement" until they are cashed off or marked complete. See Gym schedule . Does payroll pay my trainers automatically? No. Payroll works out what they are owed. You pay them yourself, or export a draft pay run to Xero . Can I see past pay periods? Yes, under Past Periods at the bottom. Does Payroll handle tax and super? No. Totality works out gross pay from your rates. Tax, super and payslips are handled in your payroll system or Xero.

t: If you use Xero , Totality can send it two things: Pay runs : a draft pay run built from your Payroll rates and work, ready to check and approve in Xero. Membership income : every member payment Totality takes, recorded in Xero as a paid invoice, with GST and Stripe fees split out. Both live on the Payroll screen (More, then Staff, then Payroll).

Connect Xero # On Payroll , find the Connect Xero Payroll card and tap Connect Xero . Sign in to Xero and pick your organisation. Allow access. Back in Totality, the card says Connected to Xero with your organisation's name. Connected to Xero Membership income to Xero

Sync your staff # Tap Sync Staff . Totality creates each of your trainers as an employee in Xero Payroll, using their name and email, and remembers the link. You see "Synced 3 trainers". Trainers already linked are counted as "already mapped". Run it again whenever you add a trainer.

Export a pay run # Make sure each trainer's pay rates are set and their sessions and classes are marked complete. Tap Export Pay Run . Enter the Pay Period Start and Pay Period End . Tap Export to Xero . Totality creates a draft pay run in Xero covering completed PT sessions (at the PT rate for that session length), completed classes (at the class rate), logged hours (at the hourly rate) and any custom amounts. Open Xero to check it, add tax and super, and approve it. If a trainer's pay cannot be worked out (a missing rate, two clashing rates, or hours with no rate), they are left out and named in the message so nobody is paid the wrong amount. A trainer who is not linked to a Xero employee is listed with "not linked to a Xero employee (tap Sync Staff)".

Membership income # Once Xero is connected, a Membership income card appears under it. Turn it on, and every member payment Totality takes (memberships, PT packages, POS and shop sales) becomes a paid sales invoice in Xero under the member's name, with GST split out. Refunds become credit notes. Turn on Membership income . Your first Xero connection was for payroll only. Tap Reconnect Xero with accounting access and allow it in Xero. Under Which Xero bank account does your card money clear into? , pick the account. Usually this is a Stripe account in Xero. Payments and Stripe fees are recorded there, so the payout matches to the cent. If you see "No bank accounts found in Xero", add one in Xero first (Accounting, then Bank accounts). Check Income account , Stripe fees account and GST . The card counts payments in Xero , waiting and failed . Payments are sent every 15 minutes, or tap Send waiting payments now . Only payments from when you switched this on are sent. Every night at 2:30am Totality compares its total for the day with Xero's. The result shows on the card, for example "Nightly check: matches". If they differ, you get a notification.
Disconnect # Tap Disconnect under the Xero buttons. Nothing already in Xero is removed.

Questions # Does Totality pay my staff through Xero? No. It creates a draft pay run. You check and approve it in Xero, and Xero handles payslips, tax and super. A trainer is missing from the pay run. Either they are not linked to a Xero employee (tap Sync Staff ), or their pay could not be worked out. The message after exporting says which, and why. Will membership income double up with my Stripe bank feed? The payments are recorded in the clearing account you pick. When Stripe pays out to your bank, reconcile the transfer from that clearing account, so each payment is only counted once. Do Totality's own reports change when I turn this on? No. Reports, Insights and Tali keep reading the same payments, so they always agree with Xero.

t: The Compliance hub keeps your staff's documents in one place, with expiry dates, so you know who is covered and who needs to renew. It is part of every gym plan Studio Club Enterprise . Open More , then Staff , then Compliance . It is also in Settings , then Compliance Hub . Your team's compliance at a glance One trainer's documents

The overview # Along the top: Fully Compliant : how many staff have every document, none expired (for example 0/4). Expiring Soon : documents expiring in the next 30 days. Expired : documents past their expiry date. Two tabs sit below: Staff : everyone at your gym, including you, with how many documents they have (for example 3/9 docs) and a badge: Compliant , Expiring Soon or Action Required . Alerts : every document expiring in the next 60 days, most urgent first. Tap one to open that person.

The documents tracked # Each person has a checklist of nine document types: First Aid Certificate Police Check Public Liability Insurance Professional Indemnity Insurance Fitness Qualification/Certification Working With Children Check Contract/Agreement COVID Vaccination Record Other Each one shows as Missing , active, Expiring Soon (within 30 days) or Expired . A document with no expiry date counts as active.

Add a document # Tap the staff member. Find the document type and tap Upload . Pick a PDF or a photo of the document. Add the Signed date , Expiry date (optional) and any Notes , then save. No file to hand? Tap Add details without a file to record the dates now and upload later. To change one, tap Edit . To swap in a renewed certificate, tap Replace . Tap View to open the file, or Delete to remove it.
Reminders # When a document has expired or expires within 30 days, a row appears on your dashboard under Needs attention today , for example "1 compliance document expired". Tap it to open the hub.

Questions # Can trainers upload their own documents? Documents are added by you, the gym owner or admin, in the Compliance hub. Ask your trainers to send you their renewed certificates. Who can see these documents? Files are stored privately for your gym. Members cannot see them. Do I need every document type for everyone? No. The hub shows the full checklist so nothing is forgotten, but only you know what your staff need. Fully Compliant counts people with all nine on file and none expired. Can I track member waivers here? The hub is for staff. Member health questions and waivers are part of client intake .

t: Incident reports gives you a digital incident form for your gym, so every slip, injury, near miss or equipment failure is written up properly and kept. Work health and safety records must be kept for at least 7 years, and the screen reminds you of that. Open More , then Staff , then Incident reports . It is also in Settings , then Incident Reports . All reports, with counts by status A report under review

The list # The top shows how many reports are Open , In Review and Closed . Each report shows its date, the person involved, the type of incident and a status badge. Tap one to read it. Reports that are Open or In Review also show on your dashboard as "2 incident reports not closed".

Write a report # Tap + New . Fill in the sections. Only the starred fields are required. Tap Save at the top. A new incident report The form follows the standard nine sections: Section What you record 1. Report Details Completed by, position or role, date of report 2. Incident Details Date and time (24 hour), location, specific area, type of incident (tick all that apply: Injury, Near-miss, Equipment failure, Slip / trip / fall, Medical episode, Property damage, Aggressive behaviour, Environmental hazard, Other) 3. Person(s) Involved Name, date of birth, phone, email, relationship to the business (client, staff, visitor), membership or client ID, anyone else involved 4. Incident Description A detailed factual account: what happened, the sequence of events, conditions, contributing factors 5. Injury Details Nature of injury, body part, first aid given and by whom, whether an ambulance was called or hospital attended 6. Witnesses Up to two witnesses with contact details and a statement summary 7. Immediate Actions Taken What was done to make the area safe and help the person 8. Follow-up Required Tick all that apply: WorkSafe notification required, Equipment inspection needed, Risk a

t: Follow up and close a report # Open the report. Next to Status , tap Change and pick Open , Under Review or Closed . To add the reviewer's sign-off or anything else, tap the edit icon, update the report and tap Save .
Delete a report # Open it and tap Delete report at the bottom. This cannot be undone, so only delete reports made by mistake. Keep real reports for at least 7 years.

Questions # Can my trainers file incident reports? Incident reports are written in the gym owner or admin login. If a trainer sees an incident, have them tell you so you can write it up, and name them in Completed by. Does Totality notify WorkSafe for me? No. Tick WorkSafe notification required as a reminder, and notify your state regulator yourself if the incident is notifiable. Can I print or export a report? Not from the app at the moment. Take a screenshot of each section if you need a copy for an insurer.

t: Clients is every member of your gym, across all your trainers. In Totality, members are called clients. Open the Members tab, then Clients , or tap Active members on the dashboard. Your members list

What each row shows # Name, email and status: Active , Inactive or Lead . Trainer : who they are assigned to. Last session : when they last logged a workout. Badges: Intake ✓ or Intake Pending : whether their intake form (PAR-Q, health history and waiver) is done. Card ✓ or No Card : whether they have a card saved with your gym. Expiring : their membership ends in the next 15 days. Tap a member to open their client detail .

Search and filter # Search clients... finds members by name or email. All shows everyone. Expiring shows members whose membership ends soon. At risk shows members with no app activity for 14 days or more. Tali can draft a nudge for them from their page. See Tali AI for gyms . A chip for each trainer shows just their members.

Do things in bulk # Tap Select . Tap members to tick them, or select all. Pick an action at the bottom: - Message : send the same message to everyone selected. It arrives in their Messages. - Assign : give them all to one trainer ( Assign Trainer ). - Status : set them all to Active, Inactive or Lead ( Change Status ). Tap Cancel to leave select mode.

Assign a trainer # To give one member to a trainer, open the member and tap Reassign Trainer under MEMBERSHIP. To move several at once, use Select then Assign as above. Assigning a member to a trainer lets that trainer coach them: programmes, sessions, check-ins and messages.

Member statuses # Status Meaning Active A current member. Counts towards your plan's member limit Inactive Not current. Keeps their history. Does not count towards your limit Lead Someone interested who has not joined yet To change one member, open them and tap Deactivate Client or Reactivate Client at the bottom of their page.

Questions # Why is a member missing? Check the search box is empty and All is selected. Members appear here once they have joined your gym. If you invited someone who already had a Totality account, they appear after they accept your invite. What is the difference between a member and a client? Nothing. Totality calls everyone who trains at your gym a client. Does making someone inactive cancel their payments? No. It only changes their status in Totality. To stop a membership payment, cancel it in Memberships . Can I delete a member? You cannot delete a member's account from the gym. Make them Inactive instead, which keeps their history. A member can delete their own account from their Settings.

Does making someone inactive cancel their payments?

t: You can add members one by one, or bring lots across at once with the Import wizard . Adding a member creates their login and adds them to your gym. Members use the app free.

Add a new member # Open the Members tab, then Add client . Or tap + Add Client on the Clients list. Type their Full Name and Email . Tap Invite Client . Add a member Their login details You see Client Invited! with their name, email and a TEMP PASSWORD . If the screen says "Invite email sent to ...", they have an email from your gym with their login details. t: Memberships is where you set up what you sell (Unlimited, Off Peak, 12 Month Upfront and so on) and where you see who is paying for which one. Your membership options Who is on each one

Create a membership # On the Products tab, tap + New . Fill in Name (for example Full Access) and an optional Description ("What's included?"). Enter the Price ($) . Pick the Billing frequency : Weekly , Fortnightly , Monthly , Quarterly or Yearly . Turn on Includes classes if members on this membership book classes for free. See Classes . Leave Active on so it can be sold. Tap Create product . A new membership Each membership shows its price and frequency (for example $29.00 AUD/wk) and a Classes pill if it includes classes. Use the switch to make it active or inactive. Tap one to edit it. Active memberships also appear in your gym's shop, where members can buy them themselves. See Marketplace and shop .

Open the Members tab and tap + New (or Add membership ). Pick the Client . Pick the Membership plan . Optional: turn on Custom amount ("Override the plan price with a custom amount") to charge a different price, then enter the Amount ($) and frequency. Tap Create subscription . Their default saved card is charged straight away, and then again on each billing date. If anything fails you will see "Could not create subscription" with the reason.

The Members tab # Each row shows the member, their membership and price, their Next bill date and a status: Status Meaning Active Paying as normal Past due The last payment failed. See Failed payments Paused Paused, for example by a freeze. See Check-in and freezes Cancelled Ended

s: Ask a member to add a card
t: Ask a member to add a card # If a member on the Members tab has no card saved, you can email them a link to add one. On the Members tab, find the member's row. Tap Ask to add card . It shows "Sending..." while it works. You see Request sent : "We emailed (their name) a link to add a card." If it could not send, you see Could not send with the reason. The email comes from your gym and links to the page where they add their card in Totality. You can also ask from the member's page. See Failed payments and cards .

Cancel a membership # On the Members tab, tap the member's row. The message says "The client will keep access until the end of the current billing period." Tap Cancel at period end , or Keep active to leave it. No more payments are taken after the current period ends. Members can also cancel their own membership from their app, at the end of the period they have paid for.

Questions # Can I change the price of a membership people are already on? To change what an existing member pays, cancel their membership at the end of the period and start them again on the new one, or with a Custom amount . Can I offer a one-off pass, like a 10 visit pass? Memberships repeat. For a one-off sale, create a product in Marketplace products with One-off billing, or use Charge a member . Can I pause a membership for an injury or holiday? Yes, with a freeze. See Check-in and freezes . What is the difference between Memberships and PT packages? Memberships are for using the gym (and classes, if included). PT packages are for 1:1 sessions with a trainer and give weekly session credits.

t: Cards expire and get declined. Failed payments lists every member payment that needs following up, so nothing slips through. Your dashboard shows the count as "2 failed payments". Open the Sales tab, then Failed payments . Failed payments, with Retry and Send update card link

What is listed # Card payments that failed in the last 120 days, unless a later retry paid them. Memberships that are past due (the last billing failed). PT packages that are past due . Each row shows the member, what it was for (for example "Off Peak membership" or "PT package past due"), when, and the amount. The header totals it up, for example "2 to follow up, about $109.00".

Retry a payment # Tap Retry . Totality tries the member's newest saved card with your gym again. While it works it says "Retrying...". If it goes through, the row shows a green tick, and it drops off the list next time you open it. If it fails again, you see why. Retrying is safe: tapping twice, or two people retrying at once, will not charge the member twice.

Send an update card link # Tap Send update card link ("Sending link..."). The member gets a push notification and an email (if their settings allow) with: a link to the Payments screen in their app, to add a new card, and when there is an unpaid invoice, a link to pay the overdue amount straight away with a new card. Once they have added a new card, tap Retry if the payment is still listed.

s: Ask a member to add a card
t: Ask a member to add a card # A member needs a card saved with your gym before you can start their membership, charge them or book them into paid classes. On the member's page, under PAYMENT : Card on file shows their card, for example Visa ending 4242. No payment method means they have not added one yet. You get two buttons: Request Payment Method : sends them a push notification ("Iron Works is requesting you to add a payment method. Open the app and go to Payments."). You see "Request sent". Add Card Manually : opens a secure Stripe page where you type the card in for them, for example at the front desk with the member there. On the Members tab in Memberships , Ask to add card on a member's row emails them a link to add a card. A member with no card on file Card details are safe Cards are stored by Stripe, in your gym's Stripe account. Totality never sees or stores the full card number.

Questions # Does Stripe retry failed membership payments by itself? Stripe may retry automatically, depending on the retry settings in your Stripe account. You do not have to wait: tap Retry any time. A member updated their card but the row is still there. Tap Retry . The payment is only cleared when it is actually paid. Why does a payment show up twice on the dashboard and here? It should not. The dashboard count and this list use the same rules, and a past due membership is only listed once even when it also has a failed payment. Pull down to refresh. Can the member pay another way? Yes. Take the money in cash or by bank transfer, then cancel or settle it in your own records. For a card payment on the spot, send a POS payment link .

Add a product # Open Sales , then Marketplace products , and tap + New . Your marketplace products A new product Pick a Product type : - Membership : ongoing gym access (also listed in Memberships ). - PT Package : a pack of sessions. Enter the Number of sessions . - Custom : anything else, like a challenge or a workshop. - Physical Product : something you hand over, like a shaker or a t-shirt. Always one-off. Enter a Name , a Description and the Price ($) . A 3.5% platform fee comes out of your payout. Buyers pay the price you set. Pick the Billing frequency : One-off , Weekly , Fortnightly or Monthly . Optional: add a Product photo . Turn on Add buyer as a client if the buyer should be added to your client list when they buy (handy for PT packs and challenges). For physical products, turn on Track stock and enter Stock on hand and Low-stock alert at . Stock goes down by the quantity bought with each sale. Leave Active on, and tap Create product . Each product shows its type, price and billing, and stock if you track it. When stock gets to your alert level it shows Low stock , and Out of stock at zero. Use the switch to hide a product without deleting it. Tap a product to edit it,

Storefront and your store link # Storefront previews your shop the way buyers see it, with filters for Memberships , PT Packages and Custom . t: Classes work in two layers: A class is the template: Strength Circuit, 45 minutes, 12 people, Sam teaching. A session is one time it runs on the timetable: Thursday 9:30am. Members see your sessions in their app, book in, and pay if the class is not covered by their membership. Classes are part of every gym plan Studio Club Enterprise . Open the Schedule tab, then Classes . Use the Classes and Sessions buttons at the top to switch. Your classes A new class

Create a class # On Classes , tap + New class . Enter the Name (for example Yoga) and an optional Description ("What's the vibe of this class?"). Set the Duration (minutes) and Capacity (the most people who can book). Pick the usual Trainer (optional) . Decide who pays (see below): turn on Included in membership , and/or set a Casual price ($) . Pick a Colour for the timetable, leave Active on, and save. Each class shows its length, capacity and price, for example "45 min · cap 12 · Members free" or "60 min · cap 16 · $30.00 casual". Use the switch to make a class inactive, or the bin to delete it.

Who pays for a class # Class setting Member on a membership with Includes classes Everyone else Included in membership on Books free Pays the casual price (free if it is $0) Included in membership off Pays the casual price Pays the casual price Casual price $0 Free Free Paid bookings are charged to the member's saved card when they book, and they get a confirmation by push and email. Set Includes classes on the membership itself in Memberships .

s: Put a class on the timetable
t: Put a class on the timetable # On Sessions , tap + Schedule . Pick the Class and the Trainer . Pick the Date and type the Start time (HH:MM, 24hr) , for example 09:00 or 18:30. Pick a Duration , or Custom (minutes) . Optional: add Notes ("Anything trainers / clients should know?"). To run it every week, turn on Recurring schedule , tick the days under Repeat on , and pick For how many weeks : 2, 4, 6, 8 or 12. Tap Schedule . You see how many sessions were scheduled. Upcoming sessions One session and its bookings The Sessions list shows each session's date, time, trainer and how full it is (for example 12 / 12 spots, in red when full).

Manage one session # Tap a session to open it: The date, time, trainer and Capacity (for example 9 / 16). Bookings : everyone booked in, and whether they are on a membership or paid. Add client : book a member in yourself. Bookings you make here are free for the member ( Book client (waived) ). Roster and attendance : mark who came. See Class roster and waitlists . Reassign trainer : pick a substitute trainer and tap Confirm reassignment . The new trainer gets a push ("New class assigned") and the session shows them. Complete : mark the session as done once it has run. Completed classes count towards the trainer's pay .

Cancel a session # Tap Cancel session on the session and confirm. Totality: cancels the session and every booking, refunds everyone who paid by card, automatically, sends every attendee a push notification and an email. You then see how many were refunded. If a refund failed, cancel the session again to retry it. Bookings paid outside Stripe are listed for you to refund yourself.

When members cancel # Members can cancel their own booking in the app any time before the class starts. Paid bookings they cancel are not refunded automatically: the app tells them to contact the gym first. If you want to refund them, email admintotality@gmail.com. When a member cancels, the next person on the waitlist gets the spot. See Class roster and waitlists .

Questions # Can a frozen member book a class? No. Members with a frozen membership cannot book until the freeze ends. See Check-in and freezes . Members are not seeing my class. Check the class is Active and that you have scheduled a session (a class with no sessions does not show on the timetable). Members only see classes at gyms they belong to. Can I change the time of one session? Cancel that session and schedule a new one at the new time. Cancelling tells everyone booked and refunds anyone who paid. Do members get reminders? Yes. Members get a push and an email about an hour before each class they have booked.

t: The Class roster is where you take attendance and look after waitlists. Open the Schedule tab, then Attendance (or Waitlists , which opens the same screen). From a class session you can also tap Roster and attendance . Today's classes, with bookings and waitlists The roster for one class

Pick a class # The screen opens on today. Use the arrows to move a day at a time. Each class shows its time, trainer, how many are booked out of the capacity (for example 12/12) and how many are waiting. If there are no classes that day you can tap Open the class timetable . Tap a class to open its roster.

Take attendance # Under ROSTER each booked member shows whether they paid, with two buttons: Attended : they came. No-show : they booked but did not come. Marked someone by mistake? Tap the same button again to clear it. Most of the time everyone comes, so tap Mark all attended at the top and then fix the odd no-show. Attendance shows on each member's status page ( Classes, 30 days and No-shows ). See Check-in and freezes .

Waitlists # When a class is full, members can join the waitlist in their app. The Waitlist section of the roster shows people in queue order, with their status: Status Meaning Waiting In the queue Spot held until ... Offered a spot, waiting for them to take it Booked Got a spot Left / Expired Left the queue, or did not take the offer in time When a spot frees up: If the class is free for that member (no casual price, or covered by their membership), the next person is booked in automatically and gets a push. If they would need to pay, they are offered the spot. It is held for up to 2 hours, or until the class starts if that is sooner, and they get a push to book and pay. If they do not, it goes to the next person. Totality checks waitlists every 5 minutes, and straight away when someone cancels. To fill spots straight away, tap Fill free spots now . To take someone off the list, tap Remove and confirm. Frozen members are skipped.

Questions # Does marking a no-show charge the member? No. It is a record only. Can I make a class bigger to fit the waitlist? Yes. Edit the class on the Classes screen and raise the capacity, then tap Fill free spots now on the roster. Do no-shows lose their booking fee? Nothing is refunded for a no-show. The booking stays as paid.

s: Put a member on a package
t: Put a member on a package # The member needs a card saved with your gym first (see Failed payments and cards ). Under Client subscriptions , tap + Assign . Pick the Client and the Package . Pick their Trainer (optional) . Credits are given for this trainer. Save. Their card is charged and billing continues on the package's frequency. Each member on a package shows the package, trainer, start date and status: Active , Past due (payment failed, see Failed payments ) or ended.

How credits work # Credits are added automatically every Sunday night for each member whose package is active and paid up. Generate this week's credits with the Generate button issues this week's batch straight away, for example to start a new member mid-week or catch up after a missed run. Credits last a year from when they are issued. Booking a PT session uses the member's oldest unused credit with that trainer. Cancelling the session gives it back. A no-show still uses it. A session booked with no credit is pending settlement . Once the member has a credit, cash it off on the gym schedule .
End a package # Tap the bin next to the member and tap End : "The client keeps their remaining credits until the current billing period ends, no charges after that." Tap Keep to leave it.

Questions # A member has no credits this week. Check their package is Active and not past due. Credits are only issued while the package is paid up. Then tap Generate . Can I sell a one-off pack of 10 sessions? You can sell a PT Package product with a number of sessions in your shop . Weekly credits for booking come from the packages on this screen. Do unused credits roll over? Yes. Unused credits stay available until they expire, a year after they were issued. Can members see their credits? Yes, members see their PT sessions and credits in their app.

t: Leads is a simple CRM for people interested in joining. Add each enquiry, move them through the stages, book a tour or trial, and convert them to a member when they sign up. The Leads CRM is part of every gym plan. Open the Members tab, then Leads . Your leads One lead

The stages # Stage Meaning New Just came in Contacted You have been in touch Trial Booked or doing a trial Converted Now a member Lost Not joining, with a reason New, Contacted and Trial are the active stages.

The list # Search leads... finds a lead by name. Showing is a dropdown to pick which stage to show, with counts. It starts on All active . Four counts across the top: Active , Overdue (follow-up date has passed), Booked (an appointment coming up) and Converted . Each lead shows their stage, email, source, how long ago they came in, and their follow-up date, marked Overdue in red when it has passed. Overdue leads sit at the top. Your dashboard also shows "Leads: 2 new, 2 follow ups due" so you do not forget them.

Add a lead # Tap + Add Lead . Enter their Full Name and, if you have them, Email and Phone . Pick the Source : Walk-in, Referral, Social Media, Website, Phone or Other. Pick the Stage . Assign To a trainer, or leave it Unassigned (it is then yours). Set the Next Follow-up date. Optional: book an Appointment : pick the Type (Call, Gym tour, Trial session or Consult), then the Date , Time and Length . Add Notes and save. A new lead If a lead with the same email or phone already exists, you see Possible duplicate and can tap Add anyway . Appointments show on the lead and in the calendar of whoever the lead is assigned to (you, if unassigned), through Calendar sync .

Work a lead # Tap a lead to open it: Call , Text and Email open your phone's dialler, messages or email. Draft a text with Tali or Draft an email with Tali writes a friendly follow-up for you to edit (1 credit). Then tap Open in Messages or Open in Mail to send it from your phone, or copy it. See Tali AI for gyms . The arrows at the top move the lead back or forward a stage. The pencil edits them.

s: Convert a lead to a member
t: Convert a lead to a member # When they join, tap Convert to Member and then Convert . This creates their Totality account and emails them an invite with their login, just like adding a member . The lead moves to Converted . The lead needs an email address first. If it is missing you see "Email required".

Lost leads # Tap Mark as Lost , add a Reason (optional) (for example "Budget constraints, signed elsewhere...") and tap Confirm Lost . If they come back, open them and tap Reopen Lead . To remove a lead completely, tap Delete lead and confirm. This cannot be undone.

Questions # Can leads come in from my website automatically? Not at the moment. Add them by hand as they come in. Can trainers see leads? Leads you assign to a trainer show in their calendar sync when they have an appointment. Managing leads is done in the gym owner or admin login. Does converting a lead start their membership? No. It creates their account and adds them to your gym. Then start their membership once they have added a card.

t: Messages # Messages is your inbox for chatting with members inside the app. Open the Members tab, then Messages . Your conversations Each conversation shows the member and when they last wrote. An orange dot means unread. Search by member name... finds a conversation. Tap a conversation to open it, type in Type a message... and tap Send . Totality Broadcasts are notices from the Totality team. "Broadcasts are read-only", so you cannot reply to them. You can also message a member from their page, or message several at once from Clients with Select , then Message . See Members . Your dashboard shows "2 unread messages" when members are waiting on you, and you get a push notification for each new message if you have notifications on.

Two ways to send announcements # Announcements Group announcements Where Members tab, Announcements Members tab, Group announcements Who it goes to Every active member All members, active members, a class's attendees, your staff, or one membership How In their in-app messages Push, email and/or in-app inbox, you choose Title No Yes Length Up to 500 characters Up to 2,000 characters

Announcements (every active member) # Open Announcements . Write your message in Write an Announcement (up to 500 characters). Tap Send to All Members . It arrives in each active member's Messages. Past Announcements lists what you have sent, with the date and how many members got it. Announcements Group announcements

Group announcements # Open Group announcements ("Send to a group by push or email"). Enter a Title (for example Public holiday hours) and your Message . Push notifications show the first 180 characters. Under Send to , pick who gets it: - All members : everyone with an active gym membership. - Active members : members with a current paid membership or PT package. - Class attendees : pick a class. Members booked into it in the last 90 days or coming up. - Trainers and staff : everyone on your team. - By membership : pick a membership. Members on that membership. Under Channels , tap Push , Email and/or Inbox . Check the count ("48 people in this group") and tap Send now . "People who turned off push or email, or unsubscribed from gym emails, are skipped automatically." Quiet hours are respected too. After sending you see how many pushes were delivered and emails sent. History shows every group announcement with its date, how many people, and how many pushes and emails went out. Announcement history

Questions # Can members reply to an announcement? Announcements are one way. Members can message you directly in Messages. Why did fewer people get my email than are in the group? People who turned off email, or unsubscribed from your gym's emails, are skipped. Can I schedule an announcement for later? Not at the moment. Announcements send straight away. Do trainers get messages from members too? Yes. Members message their own trainer in the app. You see messages sent to you.

t: There are two money screens, both under the More tab, then Insights : Revenue : money in through Stripe, your expenses and your net. Quick to check. Exports and revenue breakdown (the Insights screen): revenue split by type, product and trainer, with CSV downloads for your accountant. Part of every gym plan Studio Club Enterprise . Both need Stripe connected . Before that, Revenue shows Connect Stripe to see revenue .

Revenue # Revenue this month and expenses Business expenses and revenue by type Pick This Month , Last Month or Last 90 Days . The orange card shows what you took in that period and how many transactions. Amounts are what you receive, after the 3.5% platform fee. Expenses: this month subtracts Payroll (paid) (pay periods you marked paid in Payroll ) and Business expenses to give your NET . LAST 90 DAYS and AVG PAYMENT (per transaction). Revenue by type : PT packages, memberships, class bookings and POS. Monthly trend : a bar for each month. The recent transactions list. The download button at the top right exports the transactions as a CSV. Revenue reads straight from your Stripe account, and covers the last 90 days. Add a business expense # Rent, power, equipment and other running costs are entered by hand so your net is right. In Business expenses , tap + Add . Enter the Vendor / description , Amount (A$) and Date (YYYY-MM-DD) . Pick a category: Rent, Utilities, Equipment, Marketing, Software, Insurance, Cleaning or Other. Turn on Recurring monthly for things like rent, so it counts every month. Tap Add Expense . Tap the bin next to an expense to delete it. Staff pay is added aut

Exports and revenue breakdown # Open Insights , then Exports and revenue breakdown . Revenue, payments, refunds and failed payments By product and by trainer Pick This month , Last month , Last 30 days , Last 90 days or This year . Four totals: Revenue , Payments , Refunded and Failed payments . Memberships vs PT vs classes : revenue split into Memberships, PT, Classes, POS and Other, with percentages. By product : each membership, package, class and product, with how many payments. By trainer : "PT payments use the trainer on the member's PT package; classes use the session trainer. Memberships are usually unassigned." Export : Summary CSV (the totals and breakdowns) and All transactions CSV (every payment in the period). On a phone, the file opens your share sheet so you can email or save it.

Questions # Why do Revenue and Insights show slightly different numbers? Revenue reads directly from Stripe, after the platform fee. Insights reads Totality's own record of payments, with refunds and failed payments shown separately. They count the same payments in slightly different ways. Can I see revenue from before I joined Totality? No. Only payments taken through Totality are shown. Imported payment history is kept as a record but is not included. Where is Marketplace revenue? It has its own screen under Insights. See Marketplace and shop .

This Week # Sessions : workouts logged this week. Sets logged : total sets. Most active trainer .
Trainer Utilisation # Each trainer, ranked, with their sessions this week and how many clients they have.

Tap CSV to download them. Business expenses are entered on the Revenue screen. Monthly recurring expenses show once for each month in the range. At the bottom, "Need CSV exports or revenue by source?" links to Exports and revenue breakdown .

Sessions counts workouts their clients logged in the app this week. If clients train without logging, it will not show.

t: Tali (say "tally") is the assistant inside Totality. She reads your gym's day, flags what needs you and drafts the messages you would otherwise write yourself. Nothing is ever sent without you tapping send. Every draft is yours to read and change first. Tali comes with every gym plan. Your trainers use the same credits for their own clients. Tali says I do the first draft, you do the yes. Saves you a stack of typing, and I never send a thing on my own.

What Tali does for you # Where What Tali does Credits Dashboard Tali's brief : today's classes, this week's sessions and how many things need you Free A lead Draft a text with Tali or Draft an email with Tali : a friendly follow-up 1 A member who has gone quiet Draft a nudge with Tali on their page, sent as an in-app message from you 1 A weekly check-in from a client you coach Drafts your reply 1 New programme Draft it with Tali : a full programme using only exercises in your library 5 Your own food log Describe a meal in your own words and Tali logs it Free Your trainers use Tali the same way in their app: check-in replies, nudges for quiet clients and programme drafts, using your gym's credits. Tali drafting a lead follow-up Tali's nudge on a member's page

How a draft works # Tap the Tali button. Tali shows she is working ("Tali is thinking hard..."). The draft appears with a Drafted by Tali badge. Edit anything. "You're in charge of what gets sent." Tap Regenerate for a different version, or use it: send it, or open it in Messages or Mail.

Credits on each plan # Plan Tali credits Studio 1,000 a month Club 2,500 a month Enterprise Unlimited Credits are shared by everyone at your gym, and reset each calendar month (Sydney time). See how many are left in Settings , under TALI AI : it shows credits left and the reset date. Tali credits in Settings

Getting more credits # On Studio and Club you can add +3,000 credits a month for the whole gym for A$19.99 a month. On Studio there is also the Tali + Branding bundle , +3,000 credits and your gym's branding for A$24.99 a month. Tap Get more credits in Settings, or open Sales , then Your Totality plan , and find the TALI AI card. See Your Totality plan . If credits run out mid-month, Tali's buttons show Get more credits until they reset or you add more. Everything else in Totality keeps working.

Questions # Does Tali see my members' private details? Tali only uses what is already in your gym's Totality account to write a draft, for example a member's recent activity or a lead's notes. She never shares one member's details with another. Can Tali message members by herself? No. Tali only drafts. You or your trainer always read it and tap send. Do trainers get their own credits? No. Trainers at your gym share the gym's credits. Only you can add more. Is the brief free? Yes. Tali's brief on the dashboard costs no credits.

t: This page is about what you pay Totality. (What members pay you is in Memberships .) Open the Sales tab, then Your Totality plan , or Settings , then Subscription & Billing . If you are still on your free trial, it opens Choose a plan . Once you have subscribed, it opens your Subscription .

Subscribe # On Choose a plan , pick Monthly or Yearly · Save 15% . Read what each plan includes. While trialling, the top card says Free trial and CURRENT . Tap Subscribe on Studio, Club or Enterprise. Stripe's secure checkout opens with the price. On a monthly plan, your first-months discount is already applied. Enter your card and confirm. Come back to Totality. Your plan shows as CURRENT within a minute or so. Choosing a plan during the trial Your subscription Your paid plan starts when you subscribe, and your card is charged then. See Plans for gyms for prices and what each plan includes.

Manage : Change plan , Connect Stripe (member billing) , Products , Member billing , Charge a client (one-off) , Cancel subscription or Reactivate subscription , and Manage billing (Stripe) .

Change plan # To move to a different plan once you are subscribed: Open More , then Settings , then Subscription & Billing . Tap Change Plan . Pick Monthly or Yearly · Save 15% . Tap Switch to this plan on the plan you want. You see Plan change scheduled : "Your new plan will take effect at your next billing date." Change plan from Subscription & Billing You can also tap Change plan on the Sales subscription screen and pick a plan there. Once you are subscribed it changes your plan the same way, with the same Plan change scheduled message.
