t: Update your card or see invoices # Tap Manage billing (Stripe) . Stripe's billing page opens, where you can change your card, see past invoices and download receipts. If a payment fails, the screen shows Payment failed with Update payment method , and your dashboard shows "Your Totality payment failed". Update your card straight away to avoid any interruption.

Cancel # Tap Cancel subscription . Read "You will keep access until the end of the current billing period. You can reactivate before then." Tap Cancel plan , or Keep plan to stay. The screen then shows "Cancels on" with the date. Changed your mind? Tap Reactivate subscription before that date. When the period ends, your account becomes read only, like at the end of a trial. Your members, programmes and history are kept safe. Choose a plan any time to switch everything back on. Members' payments Cancelling your Totality plan does not cancel your members' memberships with you. Cancel those in Memberships first if you are closing your gym.

Questions # Can I switch from monthly to yearly? Yes. In Settings , then Subscription & Billing , tap Change Plan , pick Yearly · Save 15% and tap Switch to this plan on your plan. The change takes effect at your next billing date. Where do I get a tax invoice? Tap Manage billing (Stripe) and open the invoice you need. What happens if my card fails? Your plan shows Payment failed . Tap Update payment method and add a working card. Stripe tries again. Can I pause my plan? No. You can cancel at the end of a period and subscribe again later. Your data is kept.

t: Sign out # Tap Sign out at the bottom of Settings , or at the bottom of the dashboard. On a shared front desk computer, always sign out at the end of the day.

Your data # Your gym's data belongs to you. You can download it at any time: Transactions and revenue summary : Insights, then Exports and revenue breakdown, then Summary CSV or All transactions CSV . See Revenue and insights . Revenue transactions (last 90 days): the download button on Revenue. Expenses : Reports, then Expenses, then CSV . Pay periods : Payroll, then a trainer's period, then Export CSV . If you need anything else, such as a full export of your members, email admintotality@gmail.com.

Privacy # Totality 360 Pty Ltd handles personal information under the Australian Privacy Principles. Read the full Privacy Policy and Terms & Conditions , also linked at the bottom of your dashboard. Members' health information from intake (PAR-Q, injuries, conditions) is only visible to your gym. Card details are held by Stripe, never by Totality. Admin notes and compliance documents are never shown to members. Someone who already has a Totality account only joins your gym, and you only see their details, after they accept your invite.

Delete your account # Before you delete Deleting your account cannot be undone. Before you do it: If you are closing the gym, cancel your members' memberships and PT packages in Memberships and PT packages , so they stop being charged. Download anything you want to keep (see Your data above). Deleting your account also cancels your gym's Totality plan in Stripe, so you are not billed again. You do not need to cancel it first. Open More , then Settings , and scroll to the bottom. Tap Delete Account . Read "This will permanently delete your account and all your data. This cannot be undone." Tap Delete My Account . You see Account deleted and are signed out. Sign out and Delete Account at the bottom of Settings If you cannot sign in, email admintotality@gmail.com from your account's email address and ask us to delete it.

Questions # If I delete my account, are my trainers and members deleted too? Their own logins are separate and are not deleted. Talk to us at admintotality@gmail.com before deleting if you are closing or selling the gym, so we can help with your trainers' and members' accounts. Can I get my account back after deleting it? No. Deleting is permanent. I'm selling my gym. Can I hand the account over? Email admintotality@gmail.com before you hand anything over, and we will talk you through the options.
